sources.entry: Manta - Flexible invoicing desktop app with beautiful & customizable templates.

summary.one_liner: Manta is a desktop app, built on Electron and React, for creating invoices, estimates, and receipts with customizable templates.
summary.what_it_does: Manta is a desktop application for making invoices with a set of customizable templates. The form fields can be toggled on or off and the settings saved as defaults. Invoice line items can be reordered by drag and drop. Logos can be supplied as SVGs for cleaner printing. Invoices can be given custom statuses and exported to PDF for printing or emailing. The README says the app stores data locally and does not send it to a server.
use_cases: export invoices to PDF for email
freelance billing without a web account
keep financial data private on your own machine
how_to_run: Clone the Manta repository to your local machine.
cd into the cloned folder (usually cd Manta).
Run yarn install to install dependencies.
Run yarn dev in one terminal tab to start webpack-dev-server.
Run yarn start in another tab to open the app.
notable: Desktop-only invoicing with no account, subscription, or server to maintain
Customizable form fields that can be saved as default settings
SVG logo support for better print output
Translations in roughly 19 languages, with more in progress
caveats: README describes the app as still in beta and far from perfect
Linux needs extra packages (icnsutils, graphicsmagick) for development, and some Linux GPU setups may show black select boxes unless hardware acceleration is disabled
Supported OS versions are set by Electron: macOS 10.9+, Windows 7+, and specific Ubuntu, Fedora, and Debian releases
